campaign: Round 4070-E: Fixed-command proprioceptive traversability judgment benchmark

validity_contract.runtime_valid: normal simulator execution, finite state, complete required logs
validity_contract.probe_valid: legal one-shot command executed with complete proprioceptive history; contact-limited or early safe stop is allowed
validity_contract.label_valid: independent physical/geometric evidence supports PASSABLE/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN; classifier output is not truth

comparison_contract.e0: q_cmd_minus_q threshold on the same probe history
comparison_contract.e2: unified interpretable rule using the same history and preregistered cutoff

sample_plan.phase1_requirement: every P0 condition has at least two independent seeds per side
sample_plan.phase2_requirement: stable P0 and key conditions receive additional repeats as feasible

stopping_rules: Do not launch formal physics trials before the matching P0 physics gate is PASS.
Actual displacement below nominal 0.10 m is an outcome category, not automatic invalidity or BLOCKED.
Never infer flexible-scene BLOCKED from PointGoal failure or low hand displacement alone.
Stop a branch after two same-cause runtime-invalid attempts and record the branch stop.
Do not overwrite a non-empty incomplete trial directory.
P1 physics-only failures cannot invalidate P0 evidence.
